analogs.covers: Solo life: a dispersing lone wolf, quiet and watchful, trailing herds at a distance and taking calves
The goal of the lone life: winning a mate with chosen gifts at the edge of a pack's territory

solo.headline: A lone dispersing wolf that trails the sauropod herds in silence and courts at the edge of other packs' land with a bowerbird's gifts.

setting.label: Nomad between other packs' territories
setting.note: Solitary Utahraptor are nomadic. They avoid occupied territories and linger at their edges only to court.

solo.playsLike: Solo you are a quiet, watchful nomad. You avoid other Utahraptor, scout herds and carnivores with your keen eyes, and trail sauropod herds at a distance, using them as an early warning and waiting for a weak calf in the breeding season. You hunt only up to Medium tier, mostly the young of herbivores, and you never eat carrion. When you want a mate you linger at the edge of a pack's territory, tolerated there in the rainy season, and win your partner through a bonding period of at least 30 minutes with gifts, play and grooming. Your path runs from loner to pair to your own pack.

why.text: Young adults leave or are exiled and roam alone in search of a mate, as dispersing wolves travel far to find a partner and found a pack.
“Quiet by nature when alone, they curiously follow herds of sauropods, using the herd to alert them of any dangerous predators”. A lone wolf keeps to the margins and lets others do the watching.
Solitary Utahraptor hunt only up to Medium tier and target “the vulnerable offspring of herbivores”, as a lone wolf switches from elk to calves and small game.
A loner will only “linger along the edges of an occupied territory” to court, like a disperser testing the edge of a rival pack's range.
The bonding period of at least 30 minutes, with gifts of shiny things, food or trophies, is the bowerbird's game, and for a loner it is the whole point.

notLike: Lone wolves scavenge when they can; a Utahraptor never eats carrion.
Wolves don't trail giant herds for safety; Utahraptor uses sauropods as its early warning system.
solo.summary: Solo bist du ein abgewanderter Einzelwolf: still, aufmerksam und immer unterwegs. Du meidest andere Utahraptor, beobachtest mit deinen scharfen Augen Herden und Räuber und folgst Sauropoden-Herden auf Abstand, weil sie dich vor Gefahren warnen. Du jagst nur bis Medium, am liebsten die Jungen von Pflanzenfressern, und Aas frisst du nicht. Willst du einen Partner, wartest du am Rand eines fremden Reviers und gewinnst ihn wie ein Laubenvogel mit Geschenken, Spiel und Fellpflege. Dein Weg führt vom Einzelgänger zum Paar und dann zum eigenen Rudel. Dryosaurus greifst du auch allein sofort an.
